payload.summary: Outside-in evidence: Bun Streams and file-stream documentation describe incremental async iteration specifically to avoid loading all binary data into memory; Node fs documentation likewise recommends streaming instead of readFile to minimize memory. This supports a bounded streaming collector, but does not remove full-input I/O or multi-file merge costs. Sources: https://bun.sh/docs/runtime/streams ; https://bun.sh/guides/read-file/stream ; https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html
